record.question: Which of the following cyber crime report was highest in Mizoram in 2021?
record.explanation: Source check: printed page 10 of 'Clinical Research Officer under H&FW Deptt 2022 Paper-II' (PDF page 10, printed '- 10') carries Q.80 with the four options in the order Financial fraud / Cyberbullying / Sextortion / Hacking, matching the input verbatim, with no underline or emphasis on any option. Evidence for the answer: Mizoram Police's State Cyber Crime Police Station records for January 2020 to March 2025 (the series that contains 2021) show financial fraud as the single largest category - 181 of 321 registered cases (56.38%), against sexual harassment 56, identity theft 31, child pornography 16, social-media harassment/cyber bullying 9 and hacking just 1 - and a separate Mizoram Police press statement states that financial fraud constitutes roughly 75% of all cyber-crime complaints reported in Mizoram. The remaining options are minor categories throughout that period, so financial fraud is the highest-reported cyber crime in Mizoram for 2021 as well. Residual uncertainty: I could not locate a published table giving a stand-alone 2021 Mizoram breakdown, so the 2021 figure is inferred from the surrounding state series rather than quoted directly.
